sentence: She decided to offer to buy a concert ticket for her friend.
synonym: propose to get a concert ticket
synonymNote: 两者都表示主动提出为某人购买演唱会门票，意思相同。

distractors.word: refuse to buy a concert ticket
distractors.note: refuse表示拒绝，意思与offer相反，不能替换。

distractors.word: forget to buy a concert ticket
distractors.note: forget表示忘记，与主动提出的意思完全不同。

distractors.word: need to buy a concert ticket
distractors.note: need表示需要，并非主动提出为别人购买。
